description: Harvest Horizon is a two-member creative studio changing how people think about farming. It helps farmers adopt smarter methods using NASA Harvest Portal data. The website lets farmers explore crop rotation options to keep soil healthy, use water wisely, and handle changing temperatures and extreme weather. Through design and data insight
summary:
We have built a website that can help farmers adapt to shifting temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, water shortages, extreme weather, and declining soil health.
Helping them explore rotation strategies that could strengthen soil health and use water wisely.
details: It helps farmers adapt to changes in weather, soil health, and temperature. As well as conserve water and plan crop rotations to protect the field. We used Base44 to create the app and used Gemini to help with prompts.
